notes.subject: duba
notes.rationale: ידה kɔrɔ ye 'ka wuli ka fɛn wuli' ye; 'duba' (min bɛ fɛn di) ye sira tilennen don Bamanankan na

notes.subject: hesed
notes.rationale: חסד: 'kanuya', 'ɲumanya' walima 'hesed' sɛbɛnnen — an mara a la Heburu fɔcogo la sariya kɔrɔfɛ

notes.subject: a ka
notes.rationale: Bamanankan bɛ nɔnabila ɲagami 'a ka' de wajibiya טוב ni חסדו kɔ

notes.subject: to jamaa
notes.rationale: Hodu ye weleli ye kɔrɔda fɛ: 'aw ye … duba' — kumasen bɛ jamaa wele

notes.subject: to Yawe
notes.rationale: Hodu ye kuraya daɲɛ ye min bɛ Yawe fɔ

translation: Aw ye Yawe duba, sabu a ka nyɛ, sabu a ka hesed kɛ waati bɛɛ la.
